scripts.build: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" uv sync && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" uv run --env-file ../../.env python -c "from app.main import app; print(app.title)" && mkdir -p .turbo-out && date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > .turbo-out/stamp
scripts.lint: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" uv run ruff check app tests scripts
